justification: Both surfaces bear shallow incised/relief carving with what appear to be creature forms, but A is a tightly organised, framed composition of stacked ornamental registers (rows of repeated leaf/tongue shapes, a zigzag band, interlace border, a small frontal figure) while B shows scattered, isolated animal-like outlines carved on irregular boulder faces with no framing or register system. Beyond the generic fact of incised figures on rock, there is no shared specific motif, relationship or layout.
